text:
Zoe L: Morning team — post-GA triage for streaming resume. We need a fast, defensible split between emergency hotfixes and backlog enhancements. Proposed rule for next 72h: hotfix if its customer-blocking OR >2% sessions OR affects dedicated tenant; everything else -> next sprint grooming. Agree?

Marcus B: Agree. Quick ask: can we add a short numeric score so PMs/support/eng can independently route without micro-decisions? Something like: score = severity*3 + pct_sessions_affected + (dedicated?10:0) + (revenue_impact?5:0). Threshold >=12 -> HOTFIX.

Hiro T: That seems reasonable. Running that against top 12 streaming items now. One note: a lot of these are "partial JSON on reconnect" which is annoying but low incidence.

Camille R: Support report: three customers on dedicated plans filed tickets complaining about resumed streams truncating; two have active onboarding. That triggers the dedicated flag.

support-bot: Query: telemetry.streams.reconnect.errors (7d) -> totals: reconnect-truncation=198 (1.9%), malformed-partial=76 (0.7%), backpressure-freeze=12 (0.11%). Top dedicated tenants: tenant-delta=62 (6.8%), tenant-epsilon=48 (5.4%), tenant-zeta=44 (5.1%).

Zoe L: With the scoring, only the tenant-scoped items cross threshold. Tentative HOTFIXes: RI-3220 (delta reconnect truncation), RI-3229 (epsilon backpressure stall). Rest go to NEXT-SPRINT: retry-ux, docs, telemetry improvements.

Marcus B: Delivery plan for hotfix: minimal surface area, patch kv-cache reconnection guard, add idempotency token check on resume, no protocol changes. Canary us-west 45m then broader.

Hiro T: I'll prep PRs and small integration tests against the replay harness. Also adding a small telemetry flag to capture reconnect session ids for 7 days for debugging (low retention).

Camille R: Customer comms: drafting an advisory to the two affected customers saying we've scheduled a targeted fix and will run a canary. Will include suggested short-term workaround: initiate a fresh session when resuming long conversations.

Zoe L: Acceptance checklist for hotfix (minimal): reproduce on replay + unit test, perf smoke (95th latency within 1.15x baseline), tenant smoke test, customer confirmation post-canary.

Marcus B: deploy-bot: please schedule canary window tonight at 01:30 UTC for us-west (45m).

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: hotfix-3220-3229 -> us-west at 2026-03-24T01:30:00Z (45m). Eng-oncall notified.

Hiro T: Quick patch ready: guard around KV cache invalidation on reconnect. Linking PR: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-3220. Marking for hotfix bundle.

Camille R: If canary green, I'll send the customer advisory and offer to validate for tenant-delta and tenant-epsilon. If fail, we'll open incident and revert.

Marcus B: Also: product card for NEXT-SPRINT to include SDK retry API, UX sample, reconnection docs, and telemetry capture work. I'll create a single epic and link the enhancement tickets.

Zoe L: Final action items: Marcus owns canary rollout + perf checks, Hiro owns PRs/tests, Camille owns customer comms, Zoe will open epic + tag enhancements for sprint grooming. We'll reconvene if canary fails or after 48h for post-rollout review. :white_check_mark:
